events.title: Stratospheric Ash Layer Peaks (-35°C)
events.description: Dense high-altitude particulate blankets the sun. Ambient surface temperatures fall to -35°C. Unheated surface pipes freeze solid across the valley.

events.title: Electrical Conduit Thermal Contraction
events.description: Sub-zero cold creeping down intake shafts causes lead-sheathed power cables to shear. Workshop machinery loses primary power until spliced.

events.title: The Black Blizzard of Day 205
events.description: A 50-knot gale blows pulverized radioactive snow from the strike crater. Exterior periscopes are scoured opaque by blown grit.

events.title: The Works Polycarbonate Frame Failure
events.description: Heavy frozen ash crushes three cold-frame roofs at The Allotments. Agronomists send runners pleading for glass and thermal insulation.

events.title: Diesel Wax Crystallization
events.description: Uncut summer diesel in the surface reserve tank gels into cloudy paraffin wax. Generators sputter and die unless cut with kerosene or glycol.

events.title: Exhaust Chimney Rime Ice Choke
events.description: Moist generator exhaust freezes instantly upon hitting -38°C outside air, building an ice collar that restricts exhaust backpressure.

events.title: Periscope Optical Hoarfrost Blindness
events.description: Heavy condensation freezes across the exterior periscope prisms. Sentry vision is reduced to zero until heated wash fluid is pumped.

events.title: Sub-Zero Battery Electrolyte Slush
events.description: Discharged backup battery cells reach their freezing point at -22°C. Battery cases bulge and crack unless insulated immediately.

events.title: Blast Hatch Hydraulic Fluid Lock
events.description: Mineral oil in the outer blast door locking rams congeals into molasses. Opening the hatch takes four times normal manual leverage.

events.title: The Deep Stasis Despair
events.description: Sixty consecutive days confined in subterranean dampness with artificial lighting triggers severe insomnia and violent verbal arguments.

events.title: Promulgation of Martial Schedule 14
events.description: Garrison provost teams establish fortified roadblocks. Any shelter refusing grain and battery tithes is designated an enemy supply depot.

events.title: Artillery Barrage on Kilometre 19
events.description: Garrison 152mm howitzers fire three hundred high-explosive rounds into the Toll Warlord fortifications. Shockwaves rattle bunker light fixtures.

events.title: The Ash Sign Penitent Pyres
events.description: Hundreds of cultists light sulfur flares and build bonfires against the blast doors of Sector 4 bunkers, demanding entry into 'the clean tombs.'

events.title: Sluice Association Water Meter Closure
events.description: The Hydro-Barons throttle the main limestone aqueduct to 20% pressure, citing uncollected salt debts and unpaid security levies.

events.title: Protocol Null Railway Cut Blast
events.description: Detachment 9 detonates eighty linear charges under the Kilometre 44 rail viaduct, collapsing twelve thousand tons of granite into the pass.

events.title: Garrison Total Mobilization Order
events.description: Major Kroll issues an edict demanding all male and female occupants aged 16–50 report to Checkpoint Gamma for trench-digging labor details.

events.title: Switchback Ambush on Convoy 4
events.description: Sector 4 Warlords hit an armed Garrison fuel convoy with RPGs. Burning diesel blackens the snow for three square miles.

events.title: The Works Tool Embargo
events.description: The Works council halts all flour deliveries to the Garrison until three requisitioned lathe chucks and four brass valves are returned.

events.title: Mortar Fragment Air Line Breach
events.description: A stray 82mm mortar casing splinters the intake mushroom hood. Raw surface fallout bypasses the coarse pre-filter until repaired.

events.title: The Kilometre 12 Executions
events.description: Sixteen Garrison conscripts who refused to advance into the contaminated crater are shot against the railway embankment.

events.title: The Great Thaw Begins (+4°C)
events.description: A sudden warm maritime front sweeps the valley. Ten months of radioactive snow melts into toxic black mud, swamping shelter sumps.

events.title: Foundation Bedrock Radon Seepage
events.description: Thawing subsoil permafrost causes bedrock settling. Radon-222 gas vents through foundation micro-fissures at 850 Bq/m³.

events.title: 142.850 MHz Continental Transponder Lock
events.description: A rhythmic carrier wave tone crackles across the emergency frequency. The icebreaker *Aurora Borealis* is broadcasting teletype manifests.

events.title: Sub-Level Sump Pump Overrun
events.description: Mud laden with coarse quartz grit jams the impeller of primary sump pump 1. Oily, radioactive water rises four inches across the battery room.

events.title: Subterranean Toxic Mold Bloom
events.description: Sudden 95% relative humidity combined with warmth triggers rapid growth of Stachybotrys mold in bunkroom mattresses and cloth storage.

events.title: The Thawing Dead of Sector 4
events.description: Receding snowdrifts reveal dozens of frozen refugees and deserters along the highway ditches. Severe psychological shock among surface parties.

events.title: Groundwater Saline Inversion
events.description: Massive surface runoff drives salt brine from ancient evaporate beds into the shallow drinking wells. Salinity triples overnight.

events.title: Coastal Icebreaker Lead Opening
events.description: Distant explosive booms echo from the northern sound as tidal pressure fractures the shore-fast ice pack, opening the shipping channel.

events.title: Aurora Borealis Final Manifest Muster
events.description: Radio transmission: the icebreaker will open its gangway at northern anchorage in 48 hours for verified shelter manifests only.

events.title: The Cold Count Isotopic Verification
events.description: Dr. Dahl's team completes the mass spectrometer run on salt chamber samples: the strike warheads were launched by unmanned automatic error.

events.title: Permafrost Slumping Shear Stress
events.description: Deep mudslides on the western ridge tilt the radio mast three degrees and compress the secondary escape tunnel.

events.title: Geothermal Well Superheated Flash
events.description: Cold surface meltwater drains directly into the volcanic fracture at Well Alpha, creating violent steam hammer in district heat mains.

events.title: The First Rye Shoots in Black Silt
events.description: The Works agronomists discover green shoots of perennial rye pushing through the irradiated alluvial mud. Morale rises across the valley.

events.title: Protocol Null Manual Override Code Broadcast
events.description: Colonel Brand transmits the final disarmament cypher on 96.100 MHz. Detonators across the rail cut safe themselves automatically.

events.title: The Iron Garrison Disbandment
events.description: Officers burn logistics logs in steel drums at Checkpoint Gamma and lead thirty trucks toward the coast. The road is open.

events.title: Day 360 — The End of the Year of Ash
events.description: The sun rises clear above the granite ridge for the first time in 360 days. The bunker hatch is unbolted. The long winter has concluded.

events.title: Granite Arsenal Munitions Cook-Off
events.description: A boiler rupture in the High Granite shell-casting hall detonates 4 tons of ammonium nitrate. Ground vibrations trigger seismic alarms across the sector.

events.title: The Shattered Rail Union Handcar Coup
events.description: Switchmen guild scouts derail a Garrison munitions flatcar at Junction 4, distributing twelve crates of 7.62mm cartridges to upland farm militias.

events.title: 8th Penal Pioneer Sump Mutiny
events.description: Conscript sappers forced to dig trenches through hot fallout turn their entrenching tools on their provost guards, fleeing into abandoned mine drifts.

events.title: Salt Cavern Blast Barrier Sealed
events.description: The Deep Salt Freeholders fire twenty charges of blasting gelatin, collapsing the southern approach tunnel to protect their subterranean hospital.

events.title: Continental Logistics Convoy Breakout
events.description: Captain Alder's armored half-tracks force the mountain toll gate at High Pass under heavy machine gun fire, carrying medical serums north.

events.title: Subterranean Insulation Smolder
events.description: An overloaded heating coil ignites polyurethane pipe insulation in the lower ducting, releasing dense hydrogen cyanide and carbon monoxide.

events.title: Pre-Exchange Chemical Munition Leak
events.description: Meltwater eroding an old civil defense dump exposes corroded drums of sulfur mustard gas. Heavy yellow mist clings to low-lying drainage ditches.

events.title: Ash Militia Upland Redoubt Construction
events.description: Upland farm cooperatives construct dry-stone sniper revetments and deadfall timber barricades along every mountain switchback approach.

events.title: Barometric Plunge to 940 hPa
events.description: The mercury column in the command post drops thirty millimeters in two hours, presaging the most violent stratospheric ash tempest of the winter.

events.title: Sector-Wide Wire-Cutting Campaign
events.description: Railway Union guerillas cut twelve miles of copper telegraph wire along the Garrison main line, completely blinding central headquarters.

events.title: Emergency Well Decontamination Shock
events.description: A volunteer dumps excessive permanganate into the central cistern, turning the tap water purple and sparking frantic rumors of deliberate poisoning.

events.title: Direct Concussion on Auxiliary Shaft 2
events.description: A 152mm artillery round detonates on the concrete apron of the auxiliary escape hatch, cracking the blast header and raining spalled concrete.

events.title: The Thin Margin, Disclosed
events.description: Audited quota water tests clean; the desalination filters' safety margin has been quietly narrowed for eleven months to hit quota targets. The disclosure forces immediate reform and spikes short-term paranoia across the sector.

events.title: The Thirsty Season
events.description: Seizing Desalination Unit 4 destroys the queue system in the process: a temporary sector-wide water shortfall with an elevated danger rating for two weeks, from which the player's own shelter is not exempt.

events.title: Why the Work Matters
events.description: Winter mortality feeds the Osteophages' trade a larger input pool. Pressed, one of them breaks their usual silence a single time to explain, plainly and without apology, why the work matters.

events.title: The Measurement Broadcast (142.850 MHz)
events.description: The Cold Count's four researchers transmit their findings on 142.850 MHz. It is not a secret; it is a measurement. Whether it is believed is another matter entirely.
